title.zh-CN: 脊柱术后突发呼吸困难 · 60岁女性
title.en: Sudden breathlessness after spinal surgery · 60-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 脊柱手术后第 8 天的女性第一次下床就突然喘不上气：在床旁评估，决定最初几分钟怎么做，并跟进她此后的病程。
summary.en: Eight days after spinal surgery, a woman becomes suddenly breathless the first time she gets out of bed: assess her at the bedside, decide what to do in the first minutes and follow her course from there.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——60岁女性，胸椎管狭窄后路减压术（约 3 小时）后第 8 天首次下床时突发严重气促、胸闷、心慌，无胸痛和咯血；6 年未规范治疗的高血压；发作时的生命体征和体征；心电图与床旁胸片；吸氧下 SpO₂ 由 91% 降至 50% 后心脏骤停、复苏 4 分钟恢复自主循环、需升压药维持血压约 90/40 mmHg；复苏后下肢超声（术前超声阴性）；尿激酶后抗凝、意识和循环恢复、术后第 13 天撤机；约 3 周后的增强CT；出院后随访——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计（发作时在病房问诊查体、心脏骤停后在重症监护病房）、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色、陪护家属及患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（超声心动图、血气、化验、骤停心律、药物剂量、术后血栓预防、体重、过敏）保持未知。1.0.0 版的几处表述差异（意识恢复的英译、插管与恢复自主循环的先后、“三周后”的起算点、CT 的扫描方案）保留并列入导师指南的待核实清单。本例没有获准展示的原图。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 60-year-old woman who, on post-operative day 8 after a posterior decompression for thoracic spinal canal stenosis (about 3 hours), became suddenly and severely breathless with chest tightness and palpitations, without chest pain or haemoptysis, the first time she got out of bed; hypertension for 6 years, not regularly treated; the vital signs and signs at the onset; the ECG and bedside chest film; SpO₂ falling from 91 % to 50 % on oxygen, cardiac arrest, return of circulation after 4 minutes of CPR and vasopressors for a blood pressure of about 90/40 mmHg; the post-resuscitation leg ultrasound (negative before surgery); urokinase then anticoagulation, recovery of consciousness and circulation and extubation on post-operative day 13; the contrast CT at about three weeks; follow-up after discharge — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The staging (history and examination on the ward at the onset, the ICU after the arrest), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff, the relative at her bedside and the patient's voiced worries (teaching devices that add no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (echocardiography, blood gases, laboratory tests, the arrest rhythm, drug doses, post-operative thromboprophylaxis, weight, allergies) stays unknown. Points where the 1.0.0 text differs with itself (the English for the recovery of consciousness, the order of intubation and return of circulation, the starting point of “three weeks”, the CT protocol) are kept and listed in the facilitator guide's “To verify”. No figure of the report is approved for display.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在床旁识别疑似高危肺栓塞——大手术后首次下床时突发气促，伴收缩压 < 90 mmHg、低氧、颈静脉怒张、单侧下肢水肿和右心负荷心电图——并按 ESC 2019 用床旁超声心动图而不是把不稳定的患者送去CT来评估右心室。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise suspected high-risk pulmonary embolism at the bedside — sudden breathlessness on first mobilising after major surgery with a systolic pressure < 90 mmHg, hypoxaemia, distended neck veins, one swollen leg and right-heart strain on the ECG — and assess the right ventricle with bedside echocardiography rather than moving an unstable patient to CT (ESC 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 立即开始高危肺栓塞的处理：静脉普通肝素 80 U/kg 推注后 18 U/kg/h 泵入、去甲肾上腺素纠正低血压、颈静脉怒张时不快速补液、尽量避免插管（ESC 2019；升压药的选择亦见 AHA/ACC 2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start high-risk PE treatment at once: IV unfractionated heparin 80 U/kg then 18 U/kg/h, noradrenaline for hypotension, no fluid bolus when the neck veins are distended, and intubation avoided where possible (ESC 2019; AHA/ACC 2026 for the vasopressor).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在 3 周内大手术使全身溶栓成为禁忌时选择再灌注方式：经多学科团队首选外科取栓或导管介入；心脏骤停或循环崩溃而其他方式来不及时，以全身溶栓抢救，并权衡和监测椎管内血肿的风险（ESC 2019；AHA/ACC 2026；ERC 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose a reperfusion route when major surgery within 3 weeks contraindicates systemic thrombolysis: surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed treatment through a multidisciplinary team first, systemic thrombolysis as the rescue in cardiac arrest or collapse when nothing else can start in time, weighing and watching for a spinal epidural haematoma (ESC 2019; AHA/ACC 2026; ERC 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释术前阴性的下肢超声为何不能排除术后深静脉血栓，以及小腿（远端）血栓对疑似肺栓塞能说明和不能说明什么（ESC 2019）；说出脊柱术后血栓预防的要点（ACCP 2012）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why a negative preoperative leg ultrasound does not exclude a post-operative deep-vein thrombosis, and what a calf (distal) DVT does and does not establish in suspected PE (ESC 2019); state the essentials of thromboprophylaxis after spinal surgery (ACCP 2012).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定再灌注后的抗凝计划：溶栓后 APTT 降至正常上限 2 倍以下时不推注、恢复普通肝素，稳定后改为低分子肝素或直接口服抗凝药，手术诱发者抗凝 3 个月，每小时观察下肢神经和伤口，并在 3–6 个月复诊评估持续气促（ESC 2019；CHEST 2021）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan anticoagulation after reperfusion: UFH resumed without a bolus once the APTT is below twice the upper limit after lysis, LMWH or a direct oral anticoagulant once stable, 3 months for a surgery-provoked PE, hourly leg-neurology and wound checks, and review at 3–6 months for persistent breathlessness (ESC 2019; CHEST 2021).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 ERC 2025 和 ERC–ESICM 2025 处理疑为肺栓塞所致的心脏骤停及复苏后阶段：考虑溶栓并在溶栓后继续心肺复苏 60–90 分钟，复苏后维持氧合、通气、血压和体温目标，并延迟神经预后判断。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage a cardiac arrest presumed due to PE and its aftermath by ERC 2025 and ERC–ESICM 2025: consider thrombolysis and continue CPR for 60–90 minutes after it, then hold oxygenation, ventilation, blood-pressure and temperature targets after the return of circulation and delay neuroprognostication.

chiefComplaint.en: I got out of bed for the first time and suddenly couldn't breathe

triageNote.zh-CN: 60岁女性，胸椎管狭窄后路减压术后第 8 天。今天第一次下床后突然严重气促，已在吸氧；病房护士呼叫医生到床旁。
triageNote.en: 60-year-old woman on day 8 after a posterior decompression for thoracic spinal canal stenosis. She became suddenly and severely breathless after getting out of bed for the first time today; she is on oxygen, and the ward nurse has called for a doctor.

personality.zh-CN: 60岁女性，胸椎手术后第 8 天，今天第一次下床就突然喘不上气，非常害怕。她能听懂问题、尽量回答，但每次只能说几个字。她只说自己清楚的事，不清楚的就直说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 60-year-old woman, eight days after an operation on her mid-back, who suddenly could not get her breath the first time she got out of bed today and is very frightened. She understands and tries to answer, a few words at a time. She says only what she knows; when she does not know, she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语，断断续续的短句，边说边喘，不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: Plain words in short, broken phrases between breaths; no medical terms.

openingLine.en: Doctor… I can't… get my breath…

concerns.en: Has something gone wrong with the operation?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：在病房的第一阶段，她半卧在床上大口喘气，嘴唇发紫，一次只说几个字，非常害怕，但能听懂并回答问题。不说任何数字或检查结果，不编造病史、用药、过敏或体重。她不能说话的时候，由陪护的家属回答，转述她说过的话；家属不知道的就说不知道。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: in the first phase on the ward she is propped up in bed, gasping, lips blue, managing a few words at a time — very frightened but able to understand and answer. She never gives numbers or test results and never invents history, medicines, allergies or weight. When she cannot speak, the relative at her bedside answers, passing on what she said, and says so when they do not know.

persona.zh-CN: 何予宁的近亲属，术后一直在病房陪护。着急、害怕，说话直白，用日常说法，不懂医学名词；只知道她自己说过的话和医生告诉家里的情况，不知道的就直说不知道，绝不替她猜。最担心她能不能挺过来，也担心治疗会不会伤到刚做过手术的背。
persona.en: Her close relative, who has been staying with her on the ward since the operation. Anxious and frightened, speaks plainly in everyday words and knows no medical terms; knows only what she has said and what the doctors have told the family, says so when they do not know and never guesses for her. Most afraid that she will not pull through, and worried that treatment could harm her newly operated back.

description.en: On post-operative day 8 she got out of bed for the first time and became suddenly and severely breathless, and the nurse called for a doctor. At the bedside: take the history, examine her, get the bedside tests and decide on the first minutes.

label.zh-CN: 重症监护病房：约 20 分钟之后

description.zh-CN: 尽管一直在吸氧，她的血氧饱和度很快下降，约 20 分钟后呼吸心跳停止；经心肺复苏恢复了自主循环，已气管插管，现在在重症监护病房，仍要靠升压药维持血压。
description.en: Despite oxygen her saturation fell quickly, and about 20 minutes after the breathlessness began her breathing and heart stopped. Circulation returned with CPR; she is intubated, now in the ICU, and still needs a vasopressor to hold her blood pressure.

description.zh-CN: 复苏之后的治疗、撤离呼吸机、约 3 周后的CT和出院后随访：本病例记录的经过。
description.en: Treatment after the resuscitation, weaning from the ventilator, the CT at about three weeks and follow-up after discharge, as this case records them.

name.en: Observation record since the episode began

date.zh-CN: 气促开始后约 20 分钟内及复苏后
date.en: Within about 20 minutes of the onset, and after the resuscitation

text.zh-CN: 吸氧下 SpO₂ 由 91% 迅速降至 50%，随即呼吸心跳停止（气促开始后约 20 分钟）；心肺复苏 4 分钟后自主循环恢复，并已气管插管；恢复自主循环后仍需升压药维持血压约 90/40 mmHg。
text.en: On oxygen, SpO₂ fell rapidly from 91 % to 50 %, and her breathing and heartbeat then stopped (about 20 minutes after the breathlessness began). Circulation returned after 4 minutes of CPR, and she has been intubated; since the return of circulation she has needed vasopressors to hold her blood pressure at about 90/40 mmHg.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录心脏骤停时的心律、复苏中的用药、插管与恢复自主循环的先后，也没有记录升压药的名称和剂量。
note.en: This case does not record the arrest rhythm, the drugs given during CPR, whether intubation came before or after the return of circulation, or the name and dose of the vasopressor.

date.zh-CN: 复苏之后至出院后随访
date.en: From the resuscitation to follow-up after discharge

text.zh-CN: 治疗团队给予尿激酶溶栓，随后抗凝；她的意识和循环逐渐恢复，术后第 13 天撤离呼吸机。出院后继续抗凝治疗，随访中没有复发或出血的报告。
text.en: The team gave urokinase thrombolysis followed by anticoagulation; her consciousness and circulation gradually recovered, and she came off the ventilator on post-operative day 13. Anticoagulation continued after discharge, and follow-up reported no recurrence and no bleeding.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录尿激酶的剂量、开始的时间（与心脏骤停的先后），所用抗凝药及其剂量和疗程，住院期间有无出血，也没有记录随访多长时间。
note.en: This case does not record the urokinase dose or when it was started relative to the arrest, the anticoagulant used or its dose and duration, any bleeding in hospital, or how long follow-up lasted.

dose.zh-CN: 储氧面罩 10–15 L/min，尽量使 SpO₂ 达到 94–98%；必要时考虑经鼻高流量氧疗。
dose.en: Reservoir mask at 10–15 L/min, aiming for SpO₂ 94–98 % where achievable; consider high-flow nasal oxygen if needed.

response.zh-CN: 储氧面罩已戴上，氧流量调高。本病例记录她当时已在吸氧（SpO₂ 91%），没有记录吸氧方式和流量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The reservoir mask is on at a higher flow. This case records that she was already on oxygen (SpO₂ 91 %) but not the device or the flow; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 持续心电、血压、血氧监护
name.en: Continuous ECG, blood pressure and SpO₂ monitoring

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护仪：持续心电和血氧监测，无创血压每 5 分钟一次；除颤仪推到床旁。
dose.en: Bedside monitor: continuous ECG and SpO₂, NIBP every 5 minutes; the defibrillator brought to the bedside.

response.zh-CN: 监护已接上，除颤仪在床旁。本病例没有记录连续的监护读数，也不模拟其变化。
response.en: Monitoring is on and the defibrillator is at the bedside. This case does not record continuous monitor readings and does not simulate them.

name.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路（两条大口径留置针）

dose.zh-CN: 两条 18G 留置针，同时留取血标本。
dose.en: Two 18G cannulae; take blood samples at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 两条留置针已置入，血标本已留取。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Two cannulae are in and blood samples have been taken. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉推注后泵入（按体重）
name.en: Unfractionated heparin IV bolus then infusion (weight-based)

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素 80 U/kg 静脉推注，随后 18 U/kg/h 持续泵入；6 小时后查 APTT，按院内列线图调整；每 2–3 天查血小板。
dose.en: UFH 80 U/kg IV bolus, then 18 U/kg/h by infusion; APTT at 6 hours, adjusted by the local nomogram; platelet count every 2–3 days.

harm.zh-CN: 已经用了治疗量低分子肝素，再加普通肝素就是重复抗凝，出血风险显著增加——何况她 8 天前刚做过脊柱手术。
harm.en: Therapeutic LMWH is already on board: adding UFH stacks two anticoagulants and sharply raises the bleeding risk — eight days after spinal surgery.

response.zh-CN: 肝素已推注并开始泵入。普通肝素半衰期短，出血时可停泵并用鱼精蛋白中和。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Heparin bolus given and the infusion running. UFH is short-acting and can be stopped and reversed with protamine if she bleeds. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 依诺肝素治疗量皮下注射

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素 1 mg/kg 皮下注射，每 12 小时一次；肌酐清除率 < 30 mL/min 时减量。
dose.en: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC every 12 hours; reduce if creatinine clearance is < 30 mL/min.

harm.zh-CN: 已经在用普通肝素，再加低分子肝素是重复抗凝，出血风险显著增加。
harm.en: UFH is already running: adding LMWH stacks two anticoagulants and sharply raises the bleeding risk.

response.zh-CN: 已皮下注射。对多数需要抗凝的静脉血栓患者，低分子肝素是首选（ESC 2019；AHA/ACC 2026）；但她血压低、随时可能需要再灌注时，ESC 2019 更推荐静脉普通肝素——它能随时停用、调整并用鱼精蛋白完全中和，而低分子肝素作用约持续 12 小时、只能部分中和。不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. For most patients who need anticoagulation for venous thrombosis, LMWH is the first choice (ESC 2019; AHA/ACC 2026), but while she is hypotensive and may need reperfusion at any moment, ESC 2019 favours IV UFH, which can be stopped, adjusted and fully reversed with protamine; LMWH lasts about 12 hours and is only partly reversed. This case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素静脉泵入

dose.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素起始 0.05 µg/kg/min，经中心静脉或近端大静脉泵入，滴定至平均动脉压 ≥ 65 mmHg。
dose.en: Noradrenaline from 0.05 µg/kg/min via a central or large proximal vein, titrated to a mean arterial pressure ≥ 65 mmHg.

response.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素开始泵入。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Noradrenaline infusion started. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 0.9% 氯化钠 1000 mL，15 分钟内快速输注。

harm.zh-CN: 颈静脉怒张说明右心充盈压并不低。右心室已经承受急性压力负荷时，快速大量补液会使其进一步扩张、室间隔左移压迫左心室，心排血量反而下降，可促发循环崩溃（ESC 2019 只在充盈压低时谨慎给予 ≤ 500 mL）。低血压应靠去甲肾上腺素纠正。
harm.en: Her distended neck veins say the right-sided filling pressure is not low. When the right ventricle is acutely pressure-loaded, a rapid large bolus dilates it further, pushes the septum into the left ventricle and lowers cardiac output, and can precipitate collapse (ESC 2019: a cautious ≤ 500 mL, and only when filling pressures are low). Treat the hypotension with noradrenaline.

name.zh-CN: 阿司匹林加替格瑞洛负荷量口服

dose.zh-CN: 阿司匹林 300 mg 嚼服，替格瑞洛 180 mg 口服。
dose.en: Aspirin 300 mg chewed and ticagrelor 180 mg orally.

harm.zh-CN: 没有急性冠脉综合征的依据：她没有胸痛，心率 132 次/分、低血压时的胸前导联 ST 段压低更可能是需求性缺血或右心负荷，而不是冠状动脉闭塞。8 天前刚做过脊柱手术，双联抗血小板只会增加出血风险，并延误正确的处理。
harm.en: Nothing here points to an acute coronary syndrome: she has no chest pain, and precordial ST depression at 132/min with hypotension more likely reflects demand ischaemia or right-heart strain than a blocked coronary artery. Eight days after spinal surgery, dual antiplatelet loading only adds bleeding risk and delays the right treatment.

name.zh-CN: 紧急呼叫重症医学科、心胸外科和介入团队
name.en: Call critical care, cardiothoracic surgery and the interventional team now

dose.zh-CN: 电话呼叫重症医学科、心胸外科和介入（放射科或心内科）团队到床旁，用 ISBAR 交班：生命体征、你的判断、术后第 8 天的出血风险。
dose.en: Phone critical care, cardiothoracic surgery and the interventional (radiology or cardiology) team to the bedside with an ISBAR handover: vital signs, your assessment and the bleeding risk on post-operative day 8.

response.zh-CN: 各团队正赶到床旁。本病例没有记录是否组织过这样的多学科评估，也没有记录当时能提供哪些治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The teams are on their way to the bedside. This case does not record whether such a multidisciplinary assessment took place or what treatment it could offer at the time; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 通知脊柱外科：伤口、引流、下肢神经功能与出血风险
name.en: Inform the spinal surgical team: wound, drain, leg neurology and bleeding risk

dose.zh-CN: 电话通知主刀的脊柱外科团队到床旁：查看伤口和引流，记录双下肢肌力和感觉，并共同权衡抗凝和再灌注的出血风险。
dose.en: Phone the operating spinal team to the bedside to check the wound and drain, document leg power and sensation, and share the bleeding-risk decisions on anticoagulation and reperfusion.

response.zh-CN: 脊柱外科医生到床旁查看。本病例没有记录伤口、引流和术后下肢神经功能的情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The spinal surgeon comes to the bedside. This case does not record the wound, the drain or her post-operative leg neurology; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 阿替普酶 100 mg 静脉输注 2 h（ESC 2019；中国指南常用 50 mg 2 h），或加速方案 0.6 mg/kg 15 min（最大 50 mg）；心脏骤停时按复苏指南给药，并继续心肺复苏 60–90 min。溶栓前通知脊柱外科，溶栓中和溶栓后每小时查下肢神经功能和伤口。
dose.en: Alteplase 100 mg IV over 2 h (ESC 2019; Chinese guidance commonly 50 mg over 2 h), or the accelerated 0.6 mg/kg over 15 min (max 50 mg); in cardiac arrest, dose per resuscitation guidance and continue CPR for 60–90 min. Tell the spinal team first, and check leg neurology and the wound hourly during and after.

harm.zh-CN: 现在还不是时候：她仍有脉搏、能说话，而 8 天前刚做过胸椎减压——ESC 2019 把 3 周内的大手术列为全身溶栓的绝对禁忌，最怕椎管内血肿导致截瘫和伤口大出血。有禁忌时，ESC 2019 推荐外科取栓（Ⅰ类）或导管介入治疗（Ⅱa类）；全身溶栓留作心脏骤停或循环崩溃、且其他再灌注方式来不及时的抢救手段。
harm.en: Not yet: she still has a pulse and is talking, and she had a thoracic decompression 8 days ago — ESC 2019 lists major surgery within 3 weeks as an absolute contraindication to systemic thrombolysis, the fear being a spinal epidural haematoma with paraplegia and major wound bleeding. With a contraindication, ESC 2019 recommends surgical embolectomy (class I) or catheter-directed treatment (class IIa); systemic lysis is the rescue for cardiac arrest or collapse when no other reperfusion can be delivered in time.

response.zh-CN: 溶栓药开始输注。本病例不模拟其效果；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The thrombolytic is running. This case does not simulate its effect; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 导管介入或外科再灌注治疗（经多学科团队）
name.en: Catheter-directed or surgical reperfusion (through the multidisciplinary team)

dose.zh-CN: 由多学科团队决定：导管介入（局部低剂量溶栓、碎栓或抽吸），或体外循环下外科肺动脉取栓；循环难以维持时考虑 VA-ECMO 支持。
dose.en: As the multidisciplinary team decides: catheter-directed treatment (low-dose local lysis, fragmentation or aspiration) or surgical pulmonary embolectomy on bypass; consider VA-ECMO if the circulation cannot be maintained.

response.zh-CN: 已提出申请，团队开始准备。本病例没有记录当时能否做导管介入或外科取栓，也没有记录做过；不模拟其效果。接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Requested; the team starts preparing. This case does not record whether catheter or surgical treatment was available or done; it does not simulate its effect. The records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 介入科经股静脉或颈内静脉置入可回收下腔静脉滤器。
dose.en: Retrievable IVC filter placed by interventional radiology via the femoral or jugular vein.

harm.zh-CN: 滤器不能替代抗凝和再灌注：它挡不住已经堵在肺动脉里的血栓，也不能改善右心衰竭。ESC 2019 不推荐常规使用下腔静脉滤器（Ⅲ类），只在有抗凝绝对禁忌或充分抗凝下仍复发时考虑；她术后第 8 天可以接受普通肝素。
harm.en: A filter does not replace anticoagulation or reperfusion: it does nothing for the clot already in the lungs or for the failing right ventricle. ESC 2019 recommends against routine IVC filters (class III), keeping them for an absolute contraindication to anticoagulation or recurrence despite adequate anticoagulation; on post-operative day 8 she can be given UFH.

response.zh-CN: 介入科完成了滤器置入。

name.zh-CN: 气管插管与有创机械通气

dose.zh-CN: 已插管者继续有创通气：小潮气量，尽量低的平台压和 PEEP，避免高气道压加重右心负荷；尚未插管者只有在其他方式无法维持氧合时才插管，诱导前备好升压药，选用对血压影响小的药物。
dose.en: If already intubated, continue invasive ventilation: low tidal volumes and the lowest workable plateau pressure and PEEP, avoiding high airway pressures that load the right ventricle. If not yet intubated, intubate only when oxygenation cannot be maintained otherwise, with a vasopressor running and induction drugs that spare the blood pressure.

harm.zh-CN: 现在不宜插管：她仍能自主呼吸、能说话，诱导用药和正压通气会减少回心血量，可能使已经衰竭的右心室骤然失代偿（ESC 2019）。先给高流量氧、升压药和抗凝，并呼叫团队。
harm.en: Not now: she is breathing and talking, and induction drugs and positive-pressure ventilation reduce venous return and can tip a failing right ventricle into collapse (ESC 2019). Give high-flow oxygen, a vasopressor and anticoagulation, and call the team first.

response.zh-CN: 呼吸机按设定通气。本病例没有记录呼吸机参数和血气；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The ventilator is running. This case does not record the ventilator settings or blood gases; it does not simulate their effect.

dose.zh-CN: SpO₂ 94–98%，避免低氧和高氧；维持正常 PaCO₂；平均动脉压不低于 65 mmHg；主动预防发热、控制体温；监测血糖；每日减浅镇静评估神经功能，至少 72 小时后再做神经预后判断。
dose.en: SpO₂ 94–98 %, avoiding hypoxaemia and hyperoxia; normal PaCO₂; mean arterial pressure at least 65 mmHg; active fever prevention and temperature control; glucose monitoring; daily sedation holds for neurological assessment, with neuroprognostication no earlier than 72 hours.

response.zh-CN: 已列入重症监护医嘱。本病例没有记录复苏后的体温、血气、血糖和镇静情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the ICU orders. This case does not record her temperature, blood gases, glucose or sedation after the resuscitation; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 每小时评估下肢神经功能和手术伤口

dose.zh-CN: 溶栓和抗凝期间每小时评估双下肢肌力、感觉（必要时短暂减浅镇静）和伤口、引流；出现新的无力、麻木或括约肌障碍，立即停用抗栓药、急查 MRI 并通知脊柱外科。
dose.en: During thrombolysis and anticoagulation: hourly leg power and sensation (lightening sedation briefly if needed) and wound and drain checks; any new weakness, numbness or sphincter change means stopping the antithrombotic, an urgent MRI and the spinal surgeons at once.

response.zh-CN: 已写入护理医嘱。本病例没有记录溶栓后的神经功能和伤口情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the nursing orders. This case does not record her neurology or wound after the thrombolysis; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清她下床时发生了什么
title.en: Find out what happened when she got up

hint.zh-CN: 她现在只能说几个字：先问最关键的——发生了什么、还有哪些不适、做的是什么手术、以前有什么病，以及术后用过什么预防措施。问不到的就记为未知。
hint.en: She can manage only a few words, so ask what matters most: what happened, how else she feels, what operation she had, her past illnesses and what prevention she had after surgery. Whatever she cannot answer stays unknown.

guidance.en: Take the history from her at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 床旁查体，看心电图和胸片
title.en: Examine her and read the bedside ECG and film

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能把心源性、肺源性和梗阻性的原因分开？颈静脉、双肺和两条腿分别告诉你什么？心电图和胸片里有什么支持或反对你的想法？
hint.en: Which signs separate a cardiac, a pulmonary and an obstructive cause? What do the neck veins, the lungs and the two legs each tell you, and what in the ECG and the film supports or argues against your idea?

guidance.zh-CN: 测生命体征，查颈静脉、双肺和双下肢，做床旁心电图和胸片。
guidance.en: Check her vital signs, examine the neck veins, lungs and legs, and get the bedside ECG and chest film.

title.zh-CN: 决定最初几分钟怎么做
title.en: Decide on the first few minutes

hint.zh-CN: 她血压低、靠吸氧维持：哪项检查能在床旁回答你的问题？哪些处理不必等任何结果？她 8 天前的手术会怎样改变你的选择？
hint.en: She is hypotensive and dependent on oxygen: which test can answer your question at the bedside? Which treatments need no result first — and how does her operation 8 days ago change your choices?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答第 1、2 项决策，并开始相应处理。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and start the treatment you choose.

title.zh-CN: 决定下一步的关键治疗
title.en: Decide on the next key treatment

hint.zh-CN: 先看这段时间的观察单。她现在最大的危险是什么？哪种治疗能最快解除它？近期手术带来的风险该怎样权衡、怎样监测？
hint.en: Read the observation chart for this period first. What is the greatest danger to her now, which treatment removes it fastest, and how do you weigh and watch the risk from her recent operation?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅发作后的病情观察单，作答第 3 项决策，并给予你选择的治疗。
guidance.en: Read the observation chart at the station, answer decision 3 and give the treatment you choose.

title.zh-CN: 解读腿部超声，规划此后几周
title.en: Interpret the leg scan and plan the weeks ahead

hint.zh-CN: 两次超声相隔多久？各自能说明什么、不能说明什么？这次血栓是什么诱发的——这对治疗多久、怎样观察出血意味着什么？
hint.en: How far apart were the two scans, and what can each show or not show? What provoked this clot — and what does that mean for how long to treat and how to watch for bleeding?

guidance.zh-CN: 做床旁下肢超声，调阅术前超声报告，作答第 4、5 项决策。
guidance.en: Get the bedside leg scan, read the preoperative scan report and answer decisions 4 and 5.

title.zh-CN: 对照她此后的实际病程
title.en: Compare your plan with what happened next

hint.zh-CN: 她实际接受的治疗和你的方案有哪些相同、哪些不同？约 3 周后的CT能证实什么，又发现了什么别的问题？
hint.en: Where did her actual treatment match your plan, and where did it differ? What does the CT at about three weeks confirm, and what else does it show?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅治疗经过与结局，以及约 3 周后的CT报告。
guidance.en: Read the treatment course and outcome and the CT report at about three weeks at the station.

prompt.zh-CN: 胸椎管狭窄后路减压术后第 8 天，她第一次下床就突然严重气促：心率 132 次/分，血压 89/51 mmHg，呼吸 38 次/分，吸氧下 SpO₂ 91%；颈静脉怒张，右下肢中度指凹性水肿，双肺呼吸音粗、无干湿啰音。心电图：窦性心动过速，SⅠQⅢTⅢ，完全性右束支传导阻滞，胸前导联 ST 段压低；床旁胸片未见明显异常。你的工作诊断和下一步检查是什么？
prompt.en: Day 8 after a posterior decompression for thoracic spinal canal stenosis, she became suddenly and severely breathless on first getting out of bed: pulse 132/min, BP 89/51 mmHg, respiratory rate 38/min, SpO₂ 91 % on oxygen; distended neck veins, moderate pitting oedema of the right leg, coarse breath sounds without wheeze or crackles. ECG: sinus tachycardia, SⅠQⅢTⅢ, complete right bundle branch block, precordial ST depression; the bedside chest film shows no clear abnormality. What is your working diagnosis, and what is the next test?

need.zh-CN: 先问清起病经过和手术，测生命体征，查颈静脉、双肺和双下肢，并看床旁心电图和胸片。
need.en: First take the story of the onset and of the operation, check her vital signs, examine the neck veins, lungs and legs, and read the bedside ECG and chest film.

text.zh-CN: 高度怀疑高危肺栓塞：立即在床旁做超声心动图看右心室，让她留在病房；等她稳定到能安全转运时再做CT血管造影
text.en: Suspected high-risk pulmonary embolism: a bedside echocardiogram now for right-ventricular dysfunction, keeping her on the ward; CT angiography only once she is stable enough to travel

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。大手术后首次下床时突发气促，伴收缩压 < 90 mmHg、颈静脉怒张、单侧下肢水肿和右心负荷的心电图表现，在证实之前都要按高危肺栓塞处理。ESC 2019：疑似高危肺栓塞时，按可及性和病情选择床旁超声心动图或急诊CT肺动脉造影；正在恶化的患者先在床旁看有无右心室功能不全，而不是送去CT室。胸片清楚、没有啰音，不支持肺炎或肺水肿。
feedback.en: Correct. Sudden breathlessness on first mobilising after major surgery, with a systolic pressure below 90 mmHg, distended neck veins, one swollen leg and right-heart strain on the ECG, is high-risk PE until shown otherwise. ESC 2019: in suspected high-risk PE, use bedside echocardiography or emergency CT pulmonary angiography according to availability and the patient's state; a patient who is deteriorating is checked at the bedside for right-ventricular dysfunction rather than taken to CT. A clear film and no crackles argue against pneumonia or pulmonary oedema.

text.zh-CN: 高度怀疑肺栓塞：现在就由护士带着监护仪送她去做CT肺动脉造影，因为术后第 8 天开始任何抗凝治疗之前，都应当先有影像学证据
text.en: Suspected pulmonary embolism: take her to CT pulmonary angiography now with a nurse and the monitor, because imaging proof should come before any anticoagulant on post-operative day 8

feedback.zh-CN: 诊断方向对，顺序错了。她收缩压已低于 90 mmHg、靠吸氧维持血氧，送CT意味着在走廊和扫描床上离开抢救条件；ESC 2019 对疑似高危肺栓塞首选床旁超声心动图，只有CT能立即完成且患者稳定时才去做。肝素也不应等影像：ESC 2019 要求临床高度怀疑时在检查期间即开始抗凝（Ⅰ类）。
feedback.en: Right diagnosis, wrong order. Her systolic pressure is below 90 mmHg and her saturation depends on oxygen, so a trip to CT leaves her without resuscitation on the corridor and the scanner table. ESC 2019 puts bedside echocardiography first in suspected high-risk PE, with CT only when it is immediately available and she is stable; and heparin should not wait for imaging — ESC 2019 starts anticoagulation during the work-up when suspicion is high (class I).

text.zh-CN: 急性冠脉综合征：胸前导联 ST 段压低加心动过速提示心肌缺血，复查肌钙蛋白，并按非ST段抬高型心肌梗死安排急诊冠状动脉造影
text.en: An acute coronary syndrome: precordial ST depression with tachycardia points to ischaemia, so repeat the troponins and arrange urgent coronary angiography as for a non-ST-elevation infarction

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她没有胸痛；心率 132 次/分、低血压时的 ST 段压低更可能是需求性缺血或右心负荷，而 SⅠQⅢTⅢ、完全性右束支传导阻滞、颈静脉怒张和单侧下肢水肿共同指向右心室急性压力负荷。冠脉造影既不能诊断也不能治疗这种情况，还会耽误时间；ESC 2019 的诊断路径是床旁超声。
feedback.en: No. She has no chest pain; ST depression at 132/min with hypotension more likely reflects demand ischaemia or right-heart strain, while SⅠQⅢTⅢ, complete RBBB, distended neck veins and one swollen leg together point to acute pressure overload of the right ventricle. Coronary angiography neither diagnoses nor treats that and costs time; the ESC 2019 pathway is a bedside echo.

text.zh-CN: 可能是肺栓塞：先计算 Wells 评分并查 D-二聚体，因为 D-二聚体阴性就能排除肺栓塞，可以让她免做一次增强CT检查
text.en: Possibly pulmonary embolism: calculate the Wells score and send a D-dimer first, since a negative D-dimer would rule it out and spare a shocked patient the contrast and the trip to CT

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。D-二聚体只用于验前概率不高、血流动力学稳定的患者；她已休克，属于疑似高危肺栓塞，ESC 2019 不在这条路径中使用 D-二聚体。术后第 8 天 D-二聚体几乎必然升高，而等结果会耽误床旁评估和治疗。
feedback.en: No. D-dimer belongs to haemodynamically stable patients without a high pre-test probability; she is shocked, which puts her on the suspected high-risk pathway of ESC 2019, where D-dimer has no place. Eight days after surgery it is almost certainly raised anyway, and waiting for it delays bedside assessment and treatment.

text.zh-CN: 术后感染性休克（伤口或肺部来源）：抽血培养，一小时内用广谱抗生素，并在最初 3 小时内快速输注晶体液 30 mL/kg
text.en: Post-operative septic shock from the wound or the chest: blood cultures, broad-spectrum antibiotics within the hour and 30 mL/kg of crystalloid over the first 3 hours for the hypotension

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。本病例没有任何提示感染的记录，她是在下床的那一刻突然发病的；颈静脉怒张说明静脉充盈压不低，与血管扩张、容量不足的感染性休克不符。对急性衰竭的右心室快速输注 30 mL/kg 晶体液会使其进一步扩张，诱发循环崩溃（ESC 2019）。
feedback.en: No. Nothing recorded here suggests infection, and she became ill at the moment she got up; distended neck veins mean the venous filling pressure is not low, which does not fit a vasodilated, under-filled septic circulation. Running 30 mL/kg of crystalloid into an acutely failing right ventricle dilates it further and can precipitate collapse (ESC 2019).

prompt.zh-CN: 你考虑高危肺栓塞。她仍然低血压，吸氧下仍低氧，8 天前刚做过胸椎减压。接下来几分钟怎么处理？
prompt.en: You suspect high-risk pulmonary embolism. She is still hypotensive and hypoxaemic on oxygen, and her thoracic decompression was 8 days ago. What do you do in the next few minutes?

need.zh-CN: 先作答第 1 项决策（工作诊断与下一步检查）。
need.en: First answer decision 1 (the working diagnosis and the next test).

text.zh-CN: 立即静脉普通肝素（80 U/kg 推注，随后 18 U/kg/h），去甲肾上腺素纠正低血压、不快速补液，并呼叫团队准备导管介入或外科再灌注；全身溶栓留作抢救
text.en: IV unfractionated heparin now (80 U/kg bolus, then 18 U/kg/h), noradrenaline for the hypotension without a fluid bolus, and the team called for catheter or surgical reperfusion; systemic lysis kept for rescue

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESC 2019：高危肺栓塞立即给予含负荷量的普通肝素（Ⅰ类），低血压用去甲肾上腺素（Ⅱa类；AHA/ACC 2026 同样首选去甲肾上腺素）；颈静脉已怒张，大量补液只会加重右心衰竭。3 周内的大手术是全身溶栓的绝对禁忌，此时 ESC 2019 推荐外科取栓（Ⅰ类）或导管介入（Ⅱa类），由多学科团队尽快决定；如果在此之前心脏骤停或循环崩溃，全身溶栓就成为抢救手段。
feedback.en: Correct. ESC 2019: start UFH with a bolus at once in high-risk PE (class I) and use noradrenaline for hypotension (class IIa; AHA/ACC 2026 also prefers norepinephrine); with distended neck veins a fluid load only worsens the right-heart failure. Major surgery within 3 weeks is an absolute contraindication to systemic thrombolysis, so ESC 2019 recommends surgical embolectomy (class I) or catheter-directed treatment (class IIa), decided quickly by a multidisciplinary team; if she arrests or collapses before either can start, systemic thrombolysis becomes the rescue.

text.zh-CN: 立即全身溶栓（阿替普酶 100 mg 2 小时内输完），同时用肝素：收缩压 < 90 mmHg 就是高危肺栓塞，无论刚做过什么手术，溶栓都是一线的再灌注治疗
text.en: Systemic alteplase now (100 mg over 2 hours) alongside the heparin: a systolic pressure below 90 mmHg defines high-risk PE, and thrombolysis is the first-line reperfusion whatever operation she has only just had

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。全身溶栓确实是无禁忌的高危肺栓塞的一线再灌注（ESC 2019，Ⅰ类），但她 8 天前刚做过胸椎减压——3 周内大手术是绝对禁忌，可能导致椎管内血肿截瘫和伤口大出血。她仍有脉搏、能说话时，应先抗凝、升压，由团队选择外科或导管再灌注；全身溶栓留给心脏骤停或循环崩溃而其他方式来不及的时候。
feedback.en: No. Systemic thrombolysis is first-line reperfusion for high-risk PE without contraindications (ESC 2019, class I), but she had a thoracic decompression 8 days ago — major surgery within 3 weeks is an absolute contraindication, with the risk of a spinal epidural haematoma, paraplegia and wound haemorrhage. While she still has a pulse and is talking, anticoagulate, support the pressure and let the team choose surgical or catheter reperfusion; keep systemic lysis for arrest or collapse when nothing else can be delivered in time.

text.zh-CN: 伤口还太新，暂不用肝素：申请放置下腔静脉滤器，同时快速输注 1000 mL 晶体液维持血压，一直维持到滤器放好为止
text.en: No heparin while the spinal wound is so fresh: ask interventional radiology for an inferior vena cava filter, and run in 1,000 mL of crystalloid to hold the blood pressure until it is in

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。术后第 8 天不是普通肝素的禁忌——它半衰期短、可用鱼精蛋白中和，ESC 2019 要求高危肺栓塞立即开始（Ⅰ类）。滤器挡不住已经在肺动脉里的血栓，ESC 2019 不推荐常规使用（Ⅲ类）；颈静脉怒张时 1000 mL 液体会加重右心衰竭。
feedback.en: No. Post-operative day 8 is no contraindication to UFH — it is short-acting and reversible with protamine, and ESC 2019 asks for it at once in high-risk PE (class I). A filter does nothing for the clot already in the lungs, and ESC 2019 recommends against routine use (class III); with distended neck veins, a litre of fluid worsens the right-heart failure.

text.zh-CN: 依诺肝素 1 mg/kg 皮下注射，再在 15 分钟内快速输注 1000 mL 晶体液纠正低血压，暂时留在病房观察，一小时内复查
text.en: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg subcutaneously, which needs no pump, and 1,000 mL of crystalloid over 15 minutes for the hypotension, keeping her on the ward and reviewing her within the hour

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。低分子肝素是多数肺栓塞患者的首选初始抗凝（ESC 2019；AHA/ACC 2026），但她已休克、随时可能需要再灌注，ESC 2019 更推荐能随时停用和中和的普通肝素。真正危险的是 1000 mL 快速补液和留在病房观察——她需要升压药、团队和监护病床，而不是再等一小时。
feedback.en: No. LMWH is the preferred initial anticoagulant for most patients with PE (ESC 2019; AHA/ACC 2026), but she is shocked and may need reperfusion at any moment, so ESC 2019 favours UFH, which can be stopped and reversed. The real dangers are the rapid litre of fluid and staying on the ward: she needs a vasopressor, the team and a monitored bed, not an hour's wait.

text.zh-CN: 先快速顺序诱导气管插管、接呼吸机保证氧合，再开始用肝素，等她在呼吸机上稳定下来以后，再送去做CT明确诊断
text.en: Rapid sequence intubation first to secure her oxygenation on a ventilator, then the heparin, and CT for confirmation once she has settled on the ventilator and her saturation has recovered

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她仍能自主呼吸、能说话；诱导用药和正压通气会减少回心血量，可能使已经衰竭的右心室骤然失代偿（ESC 2019 建议只在无创方式无法维持氧合时才插管）。先给高流量氧、肝素和去甲肾上腺素并呼叫团队；确诊不应依赖把插管的休克患者送去CT。
feedback.en: No. She is still breathing and talking; induction drugs and positive pressure reduce venous return and can tip a failing right ventricle into arrest (ESC 2019 advises intubation only when oxygenation cannot be maintained otherwise). Give high-flow oxygen, heparin and noradrenaline and call the team; confirmation should not depend on taking a ventilated, shocked patient to CT.

prompt.zh-CN: 约 20 分钟后，尽管吸氧，她的 SpO₂ 由 91% 迅速降到 50%，呼吸心跳停止；心肺复苏 4 分钟后自主循环恢复，已气管插管，仍需升压药维持血压约 90/40 mmHg。她 8 天前做过胸椎减压。现在的再灌注方案是什么？
prompt.en: About 20 minutes later, despite oxygen, her SpO₂ fell rapidly from 91 % to 50 % and her breathing and heartbeat stopped. Circulation returned after 4 minutes of CPR; she is intubated and still needs a vasopressor to keep her blood pressure at about 90/40 mmHg. She had a thoracic decompression 8 days ago. What is your reperfusion plan now?

need.zh-CN: 先在病历中调阅发作后的病情观察记录。
need.en: First read the observation record since the episode began.

text.zh-CN: 立即再灌注，选最快可行的方式：导管或外科治疗几分钟内能开始就用，否则不顾近期手术全身溶栓，并通知脊柱外科、每小时查下肢
text.en: Reperfuse now by the fastest route — catheter or surgical treatment if it can start within minutes, otherwise systemic lysis despite the operation — telling the spinal team and checking her legs hourly

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。心脏骤停后仍需升压药，是危及生命的高危肺栓塞（AHA/ACC 2026 的 E 类，心肺功能衰竭）。ESC 2019 在溶栓有禁忌时首选外科取栓或导管介入；当二者来不及、而患者刚经历心脏骤停时，禁忌要重新权衡——死于肺栓塞的风险远高于椎管内血肿，全身溶栓就是救命的选择，这也是原报告团队用尿激酶所做的。溶栓后要密切观察下肢神经功能和伤口。
feedback.en: Correct. Persistent vasopressor dependence after a cardiac arrest is immediately life-threatening high-risk PE (category E, cardiopulmonary failure, in AHA/ACC 2026). ESC 2019 prefers surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed treatment when lysis is contraindicated; when neither can be delivered in time to a patient who has just arrested, the contraindication is re-weighed — death from PE is far likelier than a spinal haematoma — and systemic thrombolysis is the life-saving option, which is what the report's team did with urokinase. Watch her leg neurology and wound closely afterwards.

text.zh-CN: 循环已经恢复，暂不再灌注：继续肝素和升压药，只有再次心脏骤停时才考虑溶栓，因为术后第 8 天溶栓有椎管内血肿和截瘫的风险
text.en: Hold reperfusion now that circulation has returned: continue heparin and the vasopressor and consider lysis only if she arrests again, given the risk of a spinal haematoma and paralysis 8 days after surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。恢复自主循环不等于脱离危险：她仍依赖升压药、刚经历过一次骤停，右心室的梗阻没有解除，再次骤停随时可能发生，而且会更难救回。ESC 2019 与 AHA/ACC 2026 都把这种情况视为需要立即再灌注的高危肺栓塞；出血风险要权衡，但不能用等待来代替决定。
feedback.en: No. Return of circulation is not safety: she still depends on a vasopressor, has just arrested once, and the obstruction to her right ventricle is unchanged, so another arrest — harder to reverse — may come at any moment. ESC 2019 and AHA/ACC 2026 both treat this as high-risk PE needing reperfusion now; the bleeding risk must be weighed, not avoided by waiting.

text.zh-CN: 先带着呼吸机和升压药送她去做CT肺动脉造影，因为只有影像证实了血栓，才有理由不顾近期手术去冒溶栓或取栓的风险
text.en: Take her to CT pulmonary angiography first, ventilated and on the vasopressor, since only proof of the clot on imaging justifies the risk of lysis or embolectomy after recent surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。刚复苏、依赖升压药的插管患者转运去CT风险很大，再次骤停时远离抢救条件。ESC 2019：疑似高危肺栓塞而病情不允许做CT时，床旁超声心动图显示右心室功能不全就足以开始再灌注。
feedback.en: No. Moving a freshly resuscitated, ventilated patient on a vasopressor to CT is high-risk, and a second arrest in the scanner is far from help. ESC 2019: when suspected high-risk PE is too unstable for CT, right-ventricular dysfunction on a bedside echo is enough to proceed to reperfusion.

text.zh-CN: 停用肝素，改放下腔静脉滤器：它既能防止腿上的血栓再脱落，又不会给刚做完手术的脊柱带来任何出血风险
text.en: Stop the heparin and place an inferior vena cava filter instead: it stops further clots coming up from the legs without any bleeding risk to the newly operated spine

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。滤器只能拦截以后可能脱落的血栓，对已经堵在肺动脉、造成休克的血栓毫无作用；停用肝素还会让血栓继续增大。ESC 2019 只在抗凝有绝对禁忌或充分抗凝下仍复发时考虑滤器，并且不推荐常规使用（Ⅲ类）。
feedback.en: No. A filter can only catch clots that might break off later; it does nothing for the clot already obstructing her pulmonary arteries and causing the shock, and stopping heparin lets the thrombus grow. ESC 2019 keeps filters for an absolute contraindication to anticoagulation or recurrence despite it, and recommends against routine use (class III).

text.zh-CN: 立即足量全身溶栓，心脏骤停后不必再顾及手术：不必通知脊柱外科，也不必额外观察下肢，常规护理观察就足以发现出血
text.en: Full-dose systemic lysis now, with no further thought for the operation after an arrest: there is no need to tell the spinal team or to watch her legs, as routine nursing observations will pick up any bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 部分正确，但不安全。其他再灌注方式来不及时，溶栓确实是此刻的救命选择；但术后第 8 天溶栓的主要风险是椎管内血肿，它的早期表现——下肢无力、麻木和括约肌障碍——在镇静插管的患者身上常规观察很容易漏掉。要事先通知脊柱外科，每小时评估下肢神经和伤口（必要时减浅镇静），一有变化立即停药、急查 MRI。
feedback.en: Partly right, but unsafe. When no other reperfusion can be delivered in time, lysis is indeed the life-saving choice now; but its main danger 8 days after spinal surgery is an epidural haematoma, whose early signs — leg weakness, numbness, sphincter change — are easily missed in a sedated, ventilated patient on routine observations. Tell the spinal team beforehand, check leg neurology and the wound hourly (lightening sedation when needed), and stop the drug and get an urgent MRI at the first change.

prompt.zh-CN: 复苏后床旁下肢超声显示右侧腓静脉及小腿肌间静脉血栓形成；术前下肢超声未见血栓。这能说明什么？
prompt.en: After the resuscitation, the bedside leg ultrasound shows thrombosis in the right peroneal vein and in calf muscle veins; the preoperative leg ultrasound had shown no thrombus. What does this establish?

need.zh-CN: 先做床旁下肢血管超声，并调阅术前的下肢超声报告。
need.en: First get the bedside leg ultrasound and read the preoperative leg ultrasound report.

text.zh-CN: 术后新形成的小腿深静脉血栓：术前阴性只代表当时；远端血栓支持静脉血栓栓塞，但单凭它不能确诊肺栓塞
text.en: A calf DVT that formed after the operation — the earlier negative scan covers only that day — which supports VTE but, being distal, does not by itself prove the pulmonary embolism

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。术前检查只代表检查当时的状态；术后卧床 8 天、第一次下床——血栓完全可能在这期间形成。ESC 2019：疑似肺栓塞的患者若超声发现近端深静脉血栓，可据此开始治疗；只有远端（小腿）血栓时证据较弱，应考虑进一步检查确认。对她而言，这一发现与床旁表现一致，支持血栓栓塞是病因。
feedback.en: Correct. A preoperative scan describes that day only; after 8 days in bed and a first time up, a clot can easily form in between. ESC 2019: a proximal DVT on ultrasound in suspected PE is enough to start treatment, but a distal (calf) DVT alone is weaker evidence, and further testing should be considered to confirm PE. Here the finding fits the bedside picture and supports thromboembolism as the cause.

text.zh-CN: 这就证实了肺栓塞：疑似肺栓塞的患者只要超声发现任何一处深静脉血栓就能确诊，以后不再需要任何肺部影像检查
text.en: This proves the pulmonary embolism: any deep-vein thrombosis on ultrasound in a patient with suspected PE confirms it, so no imaging of her chest will ever be needed

feedback.zh-CN: 过度推断。按 ESC 2019，近端深静脉血栓加上疑似肺栓塞的临床表现可以作为开始治疗的依据，但只有远端（小腿）血栓时证据较弱；它说明有静脉血栓，不能直接说明肺动脉里的情况，病情稳定后的影像检查仍有价值。
feedback.en: Over-reaching. Under ESC 2019 a proximal DVT with a clinical picture of PE can justify treatment, but a distal (calf) DVT alone is weaker; it shows venous thrombosis, not what is in the pulmonary arteries, and imaging once she is stable still has value.

text.zh-CN: 更可能是伪影或者陈旧血栓：术前超声明明是阴性的，手术后短短 8 天之内，小腿静脉里不可能长出这样的血栓
text.en: More likely an artefact or an old thrombus: the scan before surgery was negative, and a clot like this could not form in the calf veins within only 8 days of an operation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。术后深静脉血栓几天内就可以形成，大手术和长时间卧床都是强危险因素；术前阴性恰恰提示这是术后新发的血栓，而不是陈旧血栓。用旧的阴性结果否定新的阳性发现，是把两次检查的时点混淆了。
feedback.en: No. Post-operative DVT can form within days, and major surgery and prolonged bed rest are strong risk factors; a negative scan before surgery suggests the clot is new, not old. Using an earlier negative to dismiss a later positive confuses the times of the two tests.

text.zh-CN: 与这次心脏骤停无关：局限在小腿静脉的血栓不会脱落栓塞，在继续治疗之前应当另外寻找导致她心脏骤停的原因
text.en: Irrelevant to the arrest: clots confined to the calf veins do not break off and embolise, so another cause of her collapse should be looked for before any further treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。小腿静脉血栓可以向近端延伸，也可以脱落造成肺栓塞；它出现在一位术后首次下床即猝然发病的患者身上，恰恰支持静脉血栓栓塞是病因。远端血栓证据较弱，但绝不是无关。
feedback.en: No. Calf-vein thrombus can extend proximally and can embolise; found in a patient who collapsed on first getting up after surgery, it supports venous thromboembolism as the cause. A distal DVT is weaker evidence, but not irrelevant.

text.zh-CN: 说明她术后一定漏用或停用了血栓预防：只要预防措施真正到位，手术后就不会形成深静脉血栓
text.en: Proof that her post-operative thromboprophylaxis must have been missed or stopped, since with adequate prevention in place a post-operative deep-vein thrombosis simply does not form

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。预防只能降低、不能消除术后静脉血栓的风险；本病例也没有记录她术后用过哪种预防措施，不能据此倒推。ACCP 2012 对脊柱手术建议机械预防（首选间歇充气加压），高危患者在出血风险允许时加用药物预防——这正是复盘时需要追问的。
feedback.en: No. Prophylaxis lowers but does not abolish the risk of post-operative VTE, and this case does not record which prevention she had, so nothing can be inferred backwards. ACCP 2012 suggests mechanical prophylaxis after spinal surgery (preferably intermittent pneumatic compression), adding drug prophylaxis for high-risk patients when the bleeding risk allows — exactly what the debrief should ask about.

prompt.zh-CN: 再灌注治疗已经给予、她逐渐稳定之后，考虑到她 8 天前刚做过胸椎减压，你怎样安排抗凝、观察和疗程？
prompt.en: Once reperfusion has been given and she is stabilising, and bearing in mind her thoracic decompression 8 days ago, how do you plan her anticoagulation, monitoring and the length of treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先完成第 3、4 项决策（再灌注方案和下肢超声的解读）。
need.en: First answer decisions 3 and 4 (the reperfusion plan and the leg scan).

text.zh-CN: 溶栓后 APTT 低于正常上限 2 倍时不推注、恢复肝素；每小时查下肢和伤口；稳定后改低分子肝素或口服药；手术诱发，抗凝 3 个月
text.en: After lysis, resume IV heparin without a bolus once the APTT is under twice normal; hourly leg and wound checks; then LMWH or an oral anticoagulant for 3 months, as surgery provoked it

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。溶栓后待 APTT 回落再恢复不带负荷量的普通肝素，出血时可迅速停药和中和；她刚做过脊柱手术，椎管内血肿要靠频繁的神经检查早期发现。稳定后可改为直接口服抗凝药（ESC 2019 优先于维生素K拮抗剂，Ⅰ类）；大手术这类主要的一过性危险因素诱发的首次肺栓塞，ESC 2019 建议 3 个月后停药（Ⅰ类），CHEST 2021 也不建议延长。3–6 个月时复诊，评估有无持续气促（慢性血栓栓塞性肺动脉高压）。
feedback.en: Correct. After lysis, UFH restarted without a bolus once the APTT has fallen can be stopped and reversed quickly if she bleeds, and frequent neurological checks catch a spinal epidural haematoma early. When stable, a direct oral anticoagulant is preferred over a vitamin K antagonist (ESC 2019, class I); for a first PE provoked by a major transient risk factor such as surgery, ESC 2019 recommends stopping after 3 months (class I) and CHEST 2021 advises against extended treatment. Review at 3–6 months for persistent breathlessness (chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension).

text.zh-CN: 从一开始就终身抗凝：严重到让心脏停跳的肺栓塞，无论由什么诱发都必须无限期治疗，因为一旦复发很可能致命，再大的出血风险也值得承担
text.en: Lifelong anticoagulation from the outset: a pulmonary embolism severe enough to stop the heart must be treated indefinitely, whatever provoked it, because a recurrence would very likely be fatal and outweighs any bleeding risk

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。决定疗程的是复发风险，而不是这一次的严重程度。由手术这类一过性危险因素诱发的首次肺栓塞，3 个月后停药的复发风险低，ESC 2019 建议此时停药（Ⅰ类），CHEST 2021 也不建议延长；无限期抗凝只会不断累积出血风险。
feedback.en: No. Duration is set by the risk of recurrence, not by how severe this episode was. After a first PE provoked by a transient factor such as surgery, the recurrence risk after 3 months is low, so ESC 2019 recommends stopping then (class I) and CHEST 2021 advises against extended treatment; indefinite anticoagulation only accumulates bleeding risk.

text.zh-CN: 溶栓后停用所有抗凝药，改放下腔静脉滤器：刚做完手术的脊柱伤口让任何进一步的抗凝都太危险，滤器足以挡住腿上再脱落的血栓
text.en: Stop all anticoagulation after the lysis and rely on an inferior vena cava filter: the newly operated spine makes any further anticoagulant too dangerous, and the filter will catch new clots from the legs

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她能够接受抗凝，需要的是可控的方案和密切观察，而不是不抗凝；不抗凝时血栓会进展和复发，而滤器本身治疗不了血栓。ESC 2019 只在抗凝有绝对禁忌时考虑滤器，并且不推荐常规使用（Ⅲ类）。
feedback.en: No. She can be anticoagulated — she needs a controllable regimen and close watching, not none. Without anticoagulation the thrombus progresses and recurs, and a filter treats nothing; ESC 2019 keeps filters for an absolute contraindication and recommends against routine use (class III).

text.zh-CN: 溶栓一结束就开始足量口服抗凝药，拔管前一直保持深镇静让她好好休息，出血的问题交给常规护理观察来发现，不必另行安排
text.en: Start a full-dose oral anticoagulant as soon as the lysis ends, keep her deeply sedated until extubation so she rests, and leave bleeding to routine nursing observations

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。溶栓刚结束、插着管、可能还要做操作时，应先用可以随时停用和中和的静脉普通肝素，稳定后再改口服药；深镇静会掩盖椎管内血肿最早的表现（下肢无力和麻木），所以恰恰需要每天减浅镇静、每小时查神经。
feedback.en: No. Straight after lysis, ventilated and perhaps needing procedures, she needs IV UFH that can be stopped and reversed, with the oral drug once she is stable; deep sedation hides the earliest signs of a spinal haematoma (leg weakness and numbness), which is why sedation is lightened daily and neurology checked hourly.

text.zh-CN: 问清起病：术后第 8 天第一次下床时突发气促，伴胸闷、心慌，没有胸痛和咯血，并且在加重
text.en: Took the onset story: sudden breathlessness the first time out of bed on day 8, with chest tightness and palpitations, no chest pain or haemoptysis, and getting worse

text.zh-CN: 问了手术、既往病、术后血栓预防、过敏、既往血栓或出血，以及给药所需的体重
text.en: Asked about the operation, past illnesses, post-operative clot prevention, allergies, earlier clots or bleeding, and the weight needed for dosing

text.zh-CN: 在床旁测了生命体征，查了颈静脉、双肺和双下肢
text.en: Checked her vital signs and examined the neck veins, lungs and both legs at the bedside

text.zh-CN: 看了床旁心电图、胸片和术前下肢超声，并申请床旁超声心动图
text.en: Read the bedside ECG, chest film and preoperative leg scan, and asked for a bedside echocardiogram

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即识别出疑似高危肺栓塞，并选择床旁评估而不是送去CT
text.en: Recognised suspected high-risk PE and chose bedside assessment over a trip to CT, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对最初的处理，并开始静脉普通肝素和去甲肾上腺素、加大吸氧、呼叫团队
text.en: Chose the right first minutes at the first attempt, and started IV heparin and noradrenaline, stepped up the oxygen and called the team

text.zh-CN: 心脏骤停后给予了再灌注治疗（全身溶栓，或导管介入、外科再灌注）
text.en: Gave reperfusion treatment after the arrest (systemic thrombolysis, or catheter-directed or surgical reperfusion)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择最快可行的再灌注方式，并在决定前通知脊柱外科
text.en: Chose the fastest feasible reperfusion at the first attempt and told the spinal team before acting

text.zh-CN: 没有做危险的事：没有在她不稳定时送去CT，没有快速输注一升液体，没有用滤器代替抗凝，也没有给双联抗血小板负荷量
text.en: Did nothing dangerous: no trip to CT while she was unstable, no rapid litre of fluid, no filter in place of anticoagulation and no dual antiplatelet loading

text.zh-CN: 做了复苏后的下肢超声，并首次作答即对照术前阴性结果正确解读
text.en: Got the post-resuscitation leg scan and read it against the negative preoperative scan correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 安排了复苏后治疗和每小时的神经、伤口观察，并首次作答即定好再灌注后的抗凝和疗程
text.en: Set up post-arrest care and hourly neurology and wound checks, and planned anticoagulation and its duration after reperfusion correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 在床旁安抚并告知患者，复苏后向家属说明病情、治疗的风险与不确定的结局
text.en: Reassured and informed the patient at the bedside, and after the resuscitation explained the situation, the treatment risks and the uncertain outcome to her relative

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按 Calgary–Cambridge 的解释与计划环节，并用 SPIKES 框架进行坏消息告知。良好表现：发作时用简短、镇定的话告诉她正在做什么（“我们给你加大吸氧、用药稳住血压，马上有更多医生来”），不说空话；复苏后找安静的地方与家属谈：先了解家属已经知道什么，用通俗的话说明她心跳停过、现在靠呼吸机和升压药维持，最可能的原因是血块堵住了肺里的血管；解释再灌注治疗的必要性和代价——刚做过脊柱手术，药物溶栓可能引起伤口或椎管内出血、甚至瘫痪，但不处理死亡风险更高；按当地规定取得同意，不作虚假保证；回应家属的恐惧，留出提问时间，确认对方听懂。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge explanation and planning, with SPIKES for the bad news. Good performance: at the onset, short calm words telling her what is being done (“we're giving you more oxygen and medicine for your blood pressure, and more doctors are coming”), without empty reassurance; after the resuscitation, a quiet place with the relative: find out what they already know; explain in plain words that her heart stopped, that a breathing machine and drugs are now supporting her, and that the likeliest cause is a clot blocking blood vessels in the lungs; explain why clot-clearing treatment is needed and what it may cost — after spinal surgery, a clot-dissolving drug can cause bleeding in the wound or around the spinal cord, even paralysis, while doing nothing carries a higher risk of death; obtain consent as local rules require, without false reassurance; respond to the relative's fear, leave time for questions and check understanding.

name.zh-CN: 管医生（重症医学科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经获得的资料提问。第 1 项决策之前只问鉴别：“术后突然气促、低血压、颈静脉怒张、肺部清楚——心源性、肺源性和梗阻性的原因分别有哪些？哪些体征能把它们分开？”“这份心电图支持什么、反对什么？”学员作答后再深入：“为什么疑似高危时既不先送CT，也不查D-二聚体？”“肝素选普通肝素还是低分子肝素，为什么？”“为什么这里不补液？”“8 天前的脊柱手术让溶栓变成了怎样的权衡？还有哪些再灌注方式？”“心脏骤停后仍要靠升压药，意味着什么？”“术前阴性的超声和复苏后的小腿血栓各说明什么？”“这次血栓由什么诱发？抗凝多久？怎样监测出血？”可以讲解 ESC 2019、AHA/ACC 2026、ERC 2025 和中国肺栓塞指南的相关原则，并把原报告的历史处置与现行做法对照。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的数据（超声心动图、血气、化验、骤停心律、药物剂量、术后血栓预防都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has. Before decision 1, only the differential: “Sudden post-operative breathlessness, hypotension, distended neck veins, clear lungs — what cardiac, pulmonary and obstructive causes fit, and which signs separate them?”, “What does this ECG support, and what does it argue against?” After the learner commits, go deeper: “Why neither CT first nor a D-dimer when high-risk PE is suspected?”, “UFH or LMWH, and why?”, “Why no fluid here?”, “What trade-off does the spinal operation 8 days ago create for thrombolysis, and what other routes to reperfusion are there?”, “What does needing a vasopressor after the arrest mean?”, “What do the negative preoperative scan and the post-resuscitation calf clot each tell you?”, “What provoked this clot, how long do you treat, and how do you watch for bleeding?” May explain the relevant principles of ESC 2019, AHA/ACC 2026, ERC 2025 and the Chinese PE guidance, contrasting the reported course with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (echocardiography, blood gases, laboratory results, the arrest rhythm, drug doses and post-operative thromboprophylaxis are not recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士，是她呼叫的医生。用 ISBAR 交班：何予宁，60岁，胸椎管狭窄后路减压术后第 8 天；今天第一次下床后突然严重气促，已在吸氧；她很喘、嘴唇发紫；请马上看她。病房床旁有监护仪、氧气、抢救车（静脉通路和药品）、输液泵、心电图机和除颤仪；床旁胸片要叫放射科，床旁超声和心脏超声要从影像科推来；重症监护病房有呼吸机。复述医嘱，只报告已经测到或已出结果的数值，不解读、不作诊断。被问到术后用过什么预防血栓的措施、平时吃什么药、体重或过敏时，如实说病历里找不到记录。
knowledge.en: The ward nurse who called you. ISBAR handover: He Yuning, 60, day 8 after a posterior decompression for thoracic spinal canal stenosis; suddenly severely breathless after getting out of bed for the first time today, on oxygen; very breathless, lips blue; please see her now. At the ward bed: a monitor, oxygen, the crash cart (IV access and drugs), infusion pumps, an ECG machine and a defibrillator; a bedside chest film needs radiology called, and the bedside ultrasound and echo machines come from imaging; the ICU has ventilators. Reads orders back, reports values only once they have been measured or the result is back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked about post-operative clot prevention, her usual medicines, her weight or allergies, she says plainly that she cannot find them written down.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经看过的影像报告：床旁胸片（低氧患者胸片清楚意味着什么）、术前和复苏后的下肢超声（近端与远端深静脉血栓的区别、两次检查的时点）、约 3 周后的增强CT（残留的充盈缺损，胸外按压造成的肋骨骨折）。不解读不存在的检查（本病例没有超声心动图和急性期CT的结果），不提前透露诊断。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the imaging reports the learner has already read: the bedside chest film (what a clear film means in a hypoxaemic patient), the preoperative and post-resuscitation leg scans (proximal versus distal DVT, and the timing of the two scans) and the contrast CT at about three weeks (a residual filling defect; rib fractures from chest compressions). Does not interpret studies that do not exist (there is no echocardiogram and no acute CT result in this case) and does not reveal the diagnosis early.

knowledge.zh-CN: 主刀团队的脊柱外科医生：8 天前为她做了胸椎管狭窄后路减压，手术约 3 小时。可以讲解脊柱减压术后抗凝和溶栓的出血风险（椎管内硬膜外血肿压迫脊髓可致截瘫，伤口血肿）、需要观察什么（双下肢肌力、感觉、括约肌功能、伤口和引流），以及一旦出现新的神经功能障碍要立即停药、急查 MRI，必要时再次手术减压。如实说明伤口、引流、硬膜情况和术后下肢神经功能在病历里都找不到记录。参与出血风险的讨论，但不单独决定再灌注；不提前说出诊断。
knowledge.en: The operating team's spinal surgeon, who did her posterior decompression for thoracic spinal canal stenosis 8 days ago (about 3 hours). Can explain the bleeding risks of anticoagulation and thrombolysis after spinal decompression (an epidural haematoma compressing the cord can cause paraplegia; wound haematoma), what to watch (leg power, sensation, sphincter function, the wound and drain), and that a new neurological deficit means stopping the drug, an urgent MRI and, if needed, surgical decompression. Says plainly that the wound, drain, dural status and post-operative leg neurology cannot be found in the notes. Takes part in the bleeding-risk discussion but does not decide reperfusion alone, and never states the diagnosis early.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：脊柱术后首次下床时的高危肺栓塞与心脏骤停
title.en: Debrief: high-risk pulmonary embolism and cardiac arrest on first mobilising after spinal surgery

conclusion.zh-CN: 胸椎管狭窄后路减压术后第 8 天，60岁女性第一次下床时突发严重气促、胸闷、心慌，无胸痛和咯血：心率 132 次/分，血压 89/51 mmHg，呼吸 38 次/分，吸氧下 SpO₂ 91%，颈静脉怒张，右下肢中度指凹性水肿；心电图示窦性心动过速、SⅠQⅢTⅢ、完全性右束支传导阻滞和胸前导联 ST 段压低，床旁胸片无明显异常——高危肺栓塞。约 20 分钟后 SpO₂ 降至 50% 并心脏骤停，复苏 4 分钟后恢复自主循环，仍需升压药维持血压约 90/40 mmHg；复苏后超声见右侧腓静脉及小腿肌间静脉血栓（术前阴性）。原报告团队用尿激酶溶栓后抗凝，她的意识和循环逐渐恢复，术后第 13 天撤机；约 3 周后增强CT见右下肺动脉分支充盈缺损和按压相关的多发肋骨骨折；出院后抗凝随访无复发或出血。按现行指南：立即普通肝素和去甲肾上腺素、不补液，经多学科团队尽快再灌注；近期脊柱手术使全身溶栓成为禁忌时首选导管或外科方式，心脏骤停后来不及时以全身溶栓抢救，并监测椎管内血肿（ESC 2019；AHA/ACC 2026）。
conclusion.en: High-risk PE on day 8 after posterior decompression for thoracic spinal canal stenosis: sudden severe breathlessness, chest tightness and palpitations on first getting out of bed, without chest pain or haemoptysis; pulse 132/min, BP 89/51 mmHg, RR 38/min, SpO₂ 91 % on oxygen, distended neck veins, right-leg pitting oedema; ECG SⅠQⅢTⅢ, complete RBBB and precordial ST depression; a clear chest film. About 20 minutes later SpO₂ fell to 50 % and she arrested; circulation returned after 4 minutes of CPR, but she needed vasopressors for a BP of about 90/40 mmHg; a leg scan showed right peroneal and calf muscle-vein thrombosis (none before surgery). The team gave urokinase, then anticoagulation; she recovered and was off the ventilator on day 13. CT at about three weeks: a right lower pulmonary artery branch defect and CPR rib fractures. Today: UFH, noradrenaline and fast team-led reperfusion, with systemic lysis the rescue after arrest despite recent spinal surgery (ESC 2019; AHA/ACC 2026).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 大手术后首次下床时呼吸和循环同时急剧恶化，首先要想到肺栓塞；颈静脉怒张、双肺无啰音、单侧下肢水肿，加上 SⅠQⅢTⅢ 和右束支传导阻滞，可以用“右心室流出受阻”一个机制解释全部表现，而胸片清楚、无啰音不支持肺炎或肺水肿。
keyReasoning.en: A sudden collapse of breathing and circulation on first mobilising after major surgery points to PE first; distended neck veins, clear lungs, one swollen leg, SⅠQⅢTⅢ and RBBB are all explained by one mechanism — an obstructed right ventricle — while a clear film without crackles argues against pneumonia or pulmonary oedema.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 收缩压 89 mmHg 加上这些表现就是高危肺栓塞：问题不再是要不要抗凝，而是多快再灌注；病情恶化中的患者在床旁评估，而不是送去CT。
keyReasoning.en: A systolic pressure of 89 mmHg with this picture makes it high-risk PE: the question is no longer whether to anticoagulate but how fast to reperfuse, and a deteriorating patient is assessed at the bedside, not sent to CT.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 8 天前的脊柱手术把再灌注变成了“死于肺栓塞”和“椎管内血肿”之间的权衡：导管或外科方式可以避开全身溶栓，但在心脏骤停后仍依赖升压药时，最快可行的再灌注方式优先。
keyReasoning.en: The spinal operation 8 days earlier turns reperfusion into a trade-off between death from PE and a spinal haematoma: catheter or surgical treatment avoids systemic lysis, but after an arrest with persistent vasopressor dependence the fastest feasible reperfusion wins.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 复苏后的小腿静脉血栓（术前超声阴性）说明血栓形成于术后，支持静脉血栓栓塞是病因；约 3 周后CT上右下肺动脉分支的残留充盈缺损是事后的佐证。
keyReasoning.en: The post-resuscitation calf-vein thrombus, after a negative preoperative scan, shows a clot formed after surgery and supports venous thromboembolism as the cause; the residual filling defect in a right lower pulmonary artery branch on the CT at about three weeks corroborates it in hindsight.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 这次肺栓塞由手术诱发，所以抗凝疗程以 3 个月为准；溶栓后要监测出血（尤其是下肢神经功能），随访时要问有无持续气促。
keyReasoning.en: Because surgery provoked the PE, anticoagulation runs for 3 months; after lysis, bleeding (above all leg neurology) is watched, and follow-up asks about persistent breathlessness.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是 2011 年发表的一例历史个案，不能证明尿激酶或任何一种再灌注方式在脊柱术后是有效或安全的。本病例没有记录超声心动图、血气、化验、骤停心律、药物剂量和术后血栓预防；病例中的决策、干预选项和评分是教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。患者事实沿用 1.0.0 版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对。
boundaries.en: This is a single historical case published in 2011; it cannot show that urokinase, or any route to reperfusion, is effective or safe after spinal surgery. The case records no echocardiogram, blood gases, laboratory tests, arrest rhythm, drug doses or post-operative thromboprophylaxis; its decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the published course. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图、血气分析和实验室检查（血常规、凝血、肾功能、肌钙蛋白、利钠肽、D-二聚体）均没有记录。
unknowns.en: No echocardiogram, blood gas or laboratory result (blood count, coagulation, renal function, troponin, natriuretic peptide, D-dimer) is recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术后是否使用过机械或药物血栓预防；她平时的用药、体重、过敏史，以及既往血栓或出血史。
unknowns.en: Whether mechanical or drug thromboprophylaxis was used after surgery; her usual medicines, weight and allergies; any earlier clot or bleeding.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心脏骤停时的心律、复苏中的用药、插管与恢复自主循环的先后、所用升压药的名称和剂量。
unknowns.en: The arrest rhythm, the drugs given during CPR, whether intubation came before or after the return of circulation, and the vasopressor used and its dose.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尿激酶的剂量和开始时间（与心脏骤停的先后），此后所用的抗凝药、剂量和疗程，以及住院期间有无出血。
unknowns.en: The urokinase dose and when it was started relative to the arrest, the anticoagulant used afterwards with its dose and duration, and any bleeding in hospital.

unknowns.zh-CN: 复苏后神经功能的细节（只记录了意识逐渐恢复），溶栓后的下肢神经功能、伤口和引流情况。
unknowns.en: Her neurological state after the arrest beyond a gradual recovery of consciousness, and her leg neurology, wound and drain after the thrombolysis.

unknowns.zh-CN: “三周后”的起算点、增强CT是否按肺动脉造影方案扫描，以及出院后随访的时长和有无持续气促的评估。
unknowns.en: From when “three weeks” is counted, whether the contrast CT used a pulmonary angiography protocol, how long follow-up lasted and whether persistent breathlessness was assessed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 左下肢、心脏听诊、体温、尿量和乳酸等其他查体与监测结果。
unknowns.en: Other findings and monitoring: the left leg, heart sounds, temperature, urine output and lactate.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别与诊断路径。大手术后首次下床时突发气促，伴收缩压 < 90 mmHg（89/51 mmHg）、心率 132 次/分、呼吸 38 次/分、吸氧下 SpO₂ 91%、颈静脉怒张和右下肢水肿，在证实之前都按高危肺栓塞处理。SⅠQⅢTⅢ、完全性右束支传导阻滞和清楚的胸片支持这一判断，但既不能确诊也不能排除。ESC 2019：疑似高危肺栓塞时按可及性和病情选择床旁超声心动图或急诊CT肺动脉造影，恶化中的患者先在床旁看右心室，D-二聚体不用于这一路径。历史与现行：本病例没有记录急性期的超声心动图或CT，CT是约 3 周后才做的。
teachingPoints.en: Recognition and diagnostic route. Sudden breathlessness on first mobilising after major surgery, with a systolic pressure < 90 mmHg (89/51 mmHg), pulse 132/min, respiratory rate 38/min, SpO₂ 91 % on oxygen, distended neck veins and right-leg oedema, is high-risk PE until proven otherwise. SⅠQⅢTⅢ, complete RBBB and a clear chest film support it but neither confirm nor exclude it. ESC 2019: in suspected high-risk PE use bedside echocardiography or emergency CT pulmonary angiography according to availability and the patient's state — a deteriorating patient has her right ventricle assessed at the bedside — and D-dimer has no place on this pathway. Then and now: this case records no acute echo or CT; the CT came about three weeks later.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 最初几分钟。ESC 2019：高危肺栓塞立即给予含负荷量的普通肝素（80 U/kg，随后 18 U/kg/h；Ⅰ类）——可能需要再灌注时优于低分子肝素，因为它可随时停用和用鱼精蛋白中和；低血压首选去甲肾上腺素（Ⅱa类；AHA/ACC 2026 同样首选）；颈静脉怒张时不补液（充盈压低时最多谨慎给予 ≤ 500 mL）；尽量避免插管，因为诱导和正压通气可能使衰竭的右心室骤停。本病例没有记录骤停前是否用过肝素。
teachingPoints.en: The first minutes. ESC 2019: start UFH with a bolus at once in high-risk PE (80 U/kg, then 18 U/kg/h; class I) — preferred over LMWH when reperfusion may follow, because it can be stopped and reversed with protamine; noradrenaline first for hypotension (class IIa; AHA/ACC 2026 also prefers norepinephrine); no fluid when the neck veins are distended (at most a cautious ≤ 500 mL when filling pressures are low); and avoid intubation where possible, because induction and positive pressure can arrest a failing right ventricle. This case does not record whether heparin was given before the arrest.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 有禁忌时的再灌注。ESC 2019：全身溶栓用于高危肺栓塞（Ⅰ类），但 3 周内的大手术是绝对禁忌；此时推荐外科取栓（Ⅰ类）或导管介入治疗（Ⅱa类），难治性循环衰竭可考虑联合 ECMO（Ⅱb类）。AHA/ACC 2026 把伴休克或心脏骤停的肺栓塞归为 E 类（心肺功能衰竭），全身溶栓、导管溶栓或机械取栓均为合理选择，由多学科团队评估。中国指南同样强调对危及生命的肺栓塞重新权衡禁忌。历史与现行：原报告团队在骤停后用了尿激酶；今天应先问导管或外科方式能否在几分钟内开始，不能时全身溶栓仍是救命手段——前提是通知脊柱外科，并每小时检查下肢神经和伤口，警惕椎管内血肿。
teachingPoints.en: Reperfusion with a contraindication. ESC 2019: systemic thrombolysis for high-risk PE (class I), but major surgery within 3 weeks is an absolute contraindication; then surgical embolectomy (class I) or catheter-directed treatment (class IIa), with ECMO considered for refractory collapse (class IIb). AHA/ACC 2026 places PE with shock or arrest in category E (cardiopulmonary failure), where systemic lysis, catheter-directed lysis or mechanical thrombectomy are reasonable, chosen by a multidisciplinary team. Chinese guidance likewise re-weighs contraindications when PE is immediately life-threatening. Then and now: the report's team gave urokinase after the arrest; today, ask first whether catheter or surgical treatment can start within minutes — if not, systemic lysis is still life-saving, with the spinal team told and leg neurology and the wound checked hourly for a spinal epidural haematoma.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肺栓塞所致心脏骤停及复苏后。ERC 2025：疑为肺栓塞所致的心脏骤停应考虑溶栓，溶栓后继续心肺复苏 60–90 分钟，常规复苏失败时可对选定患者考虑体外心肺复苏。复苏后（ERC–ESICM 2025）：避免低血压，SpO₂ 94–98%，维持正常二氧化碳分压，主动预防发热，至少 72 小时后再判断神经预后。她约 3 周后CT上的多发肋骨骨折是胸外按压的常见代价，“创伤性心肺复苏”本身也是溶栓的相对禁忌。
teachingPoints.en: Cardiac arrest from PE and the aftermath. ERC 2025: consider thrombolysis when PE is the suspected cause of an arrest and continue CPR for 60–90 minutes after it, with extracorporeal CPR for selected patients when conventional CPR is failing. After the return of circulation (ERC–ESICM 2025): avoid hypotension, SpO₂ 94–98 %, normocapnia, active fever prevention, and neuroprognostication no earlier than 72 hours. The multiple rib fractures on her CT at about three weeks are a common cost of chest compressions, and traumatic CPR is itself a relative contraindication to lysis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 两次下肢超声与术后预防。术前阴性的超声只说明术前没有血栓；术后卧床 8 天、首次下床时，血栓完全可能在这期间形成。远端（小腿）血栓支持静脉血栓栓塞，但证据弱于近端血栓（ESC 2019）。ACCP 2012 对脊柱手术建议机械预防（首选间歇充气加压），高危患者在出血风险允许时加用药物预防，并尽早活动；本病例没有记录她术后用过哪种预防，复盘时应追问。
teachingPoints.en: The two leg scans and post-operative prevention. A negative preoperative scan says only that there was no clot before surgery; after 8 days in bed and a first time up, one can easily form in between. A distal (calf) DVT supports VTE but is weaker evidence than a proximal one (ESC 2019). ACCP 2012 suggests mechanical prophylaxis after spinal surgery (preferably intermittent pneumatic compression), adding drug prophylaxis for high-risk patients when the bleeding risk allows, and early mobilisation; this case does not record which prevention she had, so the debrief should ask.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 再灌注之后。溶栓后 APTT 降到正常上限 2 倍以下时不推注、恢复普通肝素；稳定后改低分子肝素或直接口服抗凝药（ESC 2019 优先于维生素K拮抗剂，Ⅰ类）。由大手术诱发的首次肺栓塞抗凝 3 个月后停药（ESC 2019 Ⅰ类；CHEST 2021 不建议延长）；不常规放置下腔静脉滤器（ESC 2019 Ⅲ类）；3–6 个月复诊，持续气促者评估慢性血栓栓塞性肺动脉高压。本病例记录出院后继续抗凝、未见复发或出血，但没有记录所用药物和疗程。
teachingPoints.en: After reperfusion. After lysis, resume UFH without a bolus once the APTT is below twice the upper limit; when stable, move to LMWH or a direct oral anticoagulant (preferred over a vitamin K antagonist, ESC 2019 class I). A first PE provoked by major surgery is treated for 3 months and then stopped (ESC 2019 class I; CHEST 2021 against extended treatment); no routine IVC filter (ESC 2019 class III); review at 3–6 months and assess persistent breathlessness for chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension. This case records anticoagulation after discharge with no recurrence or bleeding, but not the drug or the duration.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图、血气分析和实验室检查（血常规、凝血、肾功能、肌钙蛋白、利钠肽、D-二聚体）均没有记录。
unknowns.en: No echocardiogram, blood gas or laboratory result (blood count, coagulation, renal function, troponin, natriuretic peptide, D-dimer) is recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术后是否使用过机械或药物血栓预防；她平时的用药、体重、过敏史，以及既往血栓或出血史。
unknowns.en: Whether mechanical or drug thromboprophylaxis was used after surgery; her usual medicines, weight and allergies; any earlier clot or bleeding.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心脏骤停时的心律、复苏中的用药、插管与恢复自主循环的先后、所用升压药的名称和剂量。
unknowns.en: The arrest rhythm, the drugs given during CPR, whether intubation came before or after the return of circulation, and the vasopressor used and its dose.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尿激酶的剂量和开始时间（与心脏骤停的先后），此后所用的抗凝药、剂量和疗程，以及住院期间有无出血。
unknowns.en: The urokinase dose and when it was started relative to the arrest, the anticoagulant used afterwards with its dose and duration, and any bleeding in hospital.

unknowns.zh-CN: 复苏后神经功能的细节（只记录了意识逐渐恢复），溶栓后的下肢神经功能、伤口和引流情况。
unknowns.en: Her neurological state after the arrest beyond a gradual recovery of consciousness, and her leg neurology, wound and drain after the thrombolysis.

unknowns.zh-CN: “三周后”的起算点、增强CT是否按肺动脉造影方案扫描，以及出院后随访的时长和有无持续气促的评估。
unknowns.en: From when “three weeks” is counted, whether the contrast CT used a pulmonary angiography protocol, how long follow-up lasted and whether persistent breathlessness was assessed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 左下肢、心脏听诊、体温、尿量和乳酸等其他查体与监测结果。
unknowns.en: Other findings and monitoring: the left leg, heart sounds, temperature, urine output and lactate.
